name: Mighty Arp
author: Moby Pixel
tagline: An FM synth with a chance arpeggiator and a step sequencer, for generative playing
description: Mighty Arp, from the creator of Mighty Synth Sampler, is a 4-op FM/subtractive synth built around a chance arpeggiator. Just hold a chord and let chance play the melody. 50 sounds plus a RANDOM mode that invents new ones, a 32-step sequencer, chords, effects and more.
credits: Built on fm1-base by Charles Vestal and felucca-bsp
